digest.component_or_area: ADR (Architecture Decision Record) numbering and indexing system
propositions: 17 ADR numbers are reused across 91 files (5× collision on 0037, 3× collisions on 0007 and 0035, plus singles on 0008-0012, 0015, 0016, 0026, 0031, 0032, 0036, 0038, 0040, 0041), with 22 files requiring renumbering to 0070-0091
Per-number marker files (docs/adr/.numbers/NNNN with content = ADR filename) and CI bijection check prevent future collisions by making add/add conflicts on git merge
Cross-references to moved ADRs must be rewritten from old to new numbers (0070-0091) using slug-exact or topic context to disambiguate; bare references recorded as UNRESOLVED
A referential-integrity gate (check_adr_numbers.py) asserts no dangling adr/NNNN-slug links exist and all intra-ADR cross-links resolve to extant files
Moved ADRs carry a 'previously numbered' header; kept ADRs (earliest-landed per collision group) carry an ambiguity-window note in docs/adr/README.md index grouped by workstream
